annotation.bound_parties_text: The bill binds law enforcement agencies and officers, individuals operating unmanned aircraft, persons flying unmanned aircraft with weapons, and political subdivisions of the state (preempted from enacting local rules).
annotation.bound_parties_quote: A law enforcement agency or officer may not obtain, receive, or use data acquired through an unmanned aircraft system unless the data is obtained:
annotation.dates_quote: This chapter supersedes any law, ordinance, or rule enacted by a political subdivision of the state before July 1, 2017.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: UNMANNED AIRCRAFT AMENDMENTS 2017 GENERAL SESSION STATE OF UTAH
